# inventory: support multiple versions

Let one record in [Inventory.yaml](../../toolset/Inventory.yaml) describe several versions or channels of the same application. **Motivation:** "to simplify the store" — 1Password 7 (App Store) and 1Password 8 (cask) were two records for one product (lines 3–14 of the file at the time, [#313](DOT-312.md)).
